newsitem.title: USA: Aviva Pet's Colombian well now producing.
newsitem.headline: Aviva Pet's Colombian well now producing.

text.p: Aviva Petroleum Inc said Thursday that its development well Linda No. 5 in the Santana contract area in Colombia is currently producing 2,500 barrels of oil per day.
The well was drilled to a depth of 9,212 feet in early May 1997, it said. Oil gravity is rated at 28.5 degrees API, it said.

On other activities in Colombia, Aviva said preliminary interpretration of its 3D seismic program earlier this year over the Mary and Miraflor areas was "encouraging" and several possibling drilling locations have been defined.

It said it has applied for environmental approval to drill the first well in a new exploration and development program in the area, which it expects to begin in early 1998. The launching of that program is subject to the completion of seismic data interpretation and receipt of government permits, it said.
